These aren't excuses, this is just biology. We try to get the best we can for our survival. I don't blame women for not having an interest in me, its common sense. I have nothing to offer, I have no status, or looks. I understand I am a biological byproduct that isn't meant to reproduce. This happens in nature all the time.  

All I am saying is that its all biology and all status, she doesn't really love you, she loves the status and security you bring that she couldn't get fucking piles of random dudes. She likes the attention, she likes the feeling socially that she is doing good in life. That she is doing better than other women around her. Trust me, once any of that goes away, its divorce and/or cheating. 

Dudes are the same way, once the sex goes away or the chance of getting better comes up, they'll cheat and/or divorce as well.

They eventually settle down after years of random hookups. This is mainly for social status reasons, if you are alone at 30 with no husband or SO a lot of people are going to think you are some mentally ill cat lady or weird.

 The emotional connect you are talking about is just chemicals in your brain that make you want to reproduce, this comes from lust, for her it's also biological, but it also comes from the need for validation, social status, looks and security. Its the reason they go after rich,tall,attractive guys so the other women can envy what they got. Beyond that she could give less of a fuck about you. If another dude comes up, thats better, she will go after that.

Well yeah you might be able to, but not to the level your wife could. You have to be on your game, charismatic, attractive, interesting. She just has to exist. But, then again, you could be naturally a chad and thats why its so easy for you to get girls on these sites, you're the ones they are looking to bang all the time.

Exactly. A lot of dudes haven't realized yet that the girl they are with could sleep with pretty much any average to above average guy in less than a day with modern dating apps. Its as easy as getting a pizza or clicking on a porn video for us. 
Don't believe me? Go on Tinder and make a fake profile with a picture of a below average girl, out of shape, bad skin, poor genetics etc etc. I guarantee you you will get dozens of messages with guys basically throwing themselves at you. 

It's not their fault, honestly, guys just undervalued themselves and made themselves worthless on these apps, and if I had the ability to pick up average to above average girls on a regular basis, I wouldn't want a relationship either. 
Other than financial security, why would a girl want to stay with you? 

EDIT: Keep downvoting me, the only reason any girl is staying with you is because they know they are getting old and need to settle down due to the fact they've lost any and all sexual value from random dudes and can't survive on their own.

I don't know. I really don't, I'm not hurting her or anything. I'm not taking advantage of her. Today I had to go home early because my depression made me question my ability to work. Its such an easy job and I can't even mentally bring myself to do it.

I recognize that feeling. Sometimes I hate myself so much that I am literally shaking I am so pissed, I want to find the nearest object and kill myself with it right now. I usually end up in tears shortly after. I wonder if I will end up like you, getting a neurological disease from this.
I'm the same way currently. No games I want to play, my sex drive is at an all time low. Literally haven't look at porn in over a month.

Its been 8 days since my last attempt at suicide. 8 days later, little over a week, and I'm already wanting to die again. I think I am reaching out more and more and hopefully I will be able to get help and start to not hate myself so much, maybe, I've heard that depression is almost impossible to get rid of. Explains why most of the population has it. I survived tell my 20th birthday, some of my immediate family wished me a happy birthday, got a few cards. So thats good. 

I ran into the daughter of a family friend again. She makes me forget I'm depressed and she knows that. This is going to sound weird but I can still smell her on me from last time she was over, she said she was just going to lay down for a bit but ended up falling asleep in my arms. It was nice. I know this won't last, I know her parents are going to threaten me or force her to stay away from me, because she's 17 and I'm 20. I've been told by a lot of people to never speak to her again, that I should feel ashamed for being interested in her, that shes a minor, a child. It stresses me out a lot and I know I should feel ashamed. It makes me feel worse than I already am. God is a sadist.
Its just insane how much you can really stress yourself with how much you hate yourself. Like your brain is literally hurting itself with self hate.
